columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a geography.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: Contains the location which is a combination of GEOGARPHY ELEMENTS4, ELEMENTS3, ELEMENTS2, ELEMENTS1 columns.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_NAME
columns.description: Describes the primary name of the geography.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Describes the type of the geography.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date from which this geography is valid for use.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which this geography is no longer valid.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT1
columns.description: Name of de-normalized parent of the geography.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2
columns.description: Name of de-normalized parent of the geography.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT3
columns.description: Name of de-normalized parent of the geography.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT4
columns.description: Name of de-normalized parent of the geography.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT5
columns.description: Name of de-normalized parent of the geography.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the Country to which the Geography belongs.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of de-normalized parent of the geography.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ELEMENT2_CODE
columns.description: Code of de-normalized parent of the geography.

columns.name: LOCATION_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the sources from which the row was added.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
